god_package.instructions: Does this directory avoid being a 'god package' (i.e. it has a small, focused set of files rather than dozens of unrelated files)?

junk_drawer_module.instructions: Does this directory avoid being a catch-all junk-drawer package (named 'utils', 'helpers', 'misc', or 'common') filled with unrelated functions?

flat_structure.instructions: Are files organized into subpackages when appropriate rather than dumping an excessive number of files into one flat directory?

excessive_nesting_depth.instructions: Is the directory nesting depth shallow and reasonable (e.g. 3 levels or fewer) rather than excessively deep?

inconsistent_naming_convention.instructions: Do all file names and subdirectory names in this directory follow a consistent naming convention (such as snake_case)?

trivial_subpackage.instructions: If this directory has subdirectories, do they avoid being trivial single-file packages that do not need their own directory?

test_structure_mismatch.instructions: If this directory is a test directory (e.g. 'tests'), does its layout mirror the source tree? (Mark Irrelevant if not a test directory.)

barrel_file_sprawl.instructions: Does this directory avoid having excessive barrel/index files that do nothing but re-export symbols across every subpackage?

circular_package_dependencies.instructions: Are the packages and subpackages in this directory tree free of circular dependencies (where Mutual Subpackage Cycles is 'none' and no two packages import from each other)?

layering_violation.instructions: Does this directory respect architectural layer boundaries (core/domain must not import from infrastructure or cli; infrastructure must not import from cli/entrypoints)?

god_file_or_class.instructions: Are all files in this directory reasonably sized (e.g. under 300 lines) rather than overly large 'god' files or classes?

duplicate_modules.instructions: Are the files in this directory distinct in purpose rather than near-duplicate modules with redundant classes/functions?

leaky_abstraction.instructions: If this directory is in the core/domain layer, does it avoid importing third-party frameworks, HTTP clients, or torch/ORM libraries? (Mark Irrelevant if not core/domain.)

business_logic_in_presentation_layer.instructions: If this directory is a CLI or presentation layer, does it delegate core auditing/business logic to services instead of implementing domain logic directly? (Mark Irrelevant if not CLI/presentation.)

dead_code_module.instructions: Are the modules in this directory imported and used by other modules in the directory tree?

missing_package_public_api.instructions: If this directory is a multi-file library subpackage (excluding pure parent namespace directories with 0 files and CLI entrypoint folders), does it provide an __init__.py with exports?

scattered_feature_logic.instructions: Are the files within this directory cohesive and focused on a single architectural concern?

inconsistent_architectural_style.instructions: Does the structure of this directory follow a clean layered/hexagonal architecture consistent with its subpackages?
